left.en: The three friends start a band!

right.pt-BR: Os passarinhos já cantam em coro.
right.en: The birds already sing in a choir.
right.es-MX: Los pajaritos ya cantan en coro.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Theo and Lia sit in a row on the grass with pots, spoons and a toy drum; on the right a row of little birds sits on a branch singing together with their beaks open, in the same row. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a tree branch band through the middle, a backyard grass band along the bottom.

right.pt-BR: A baleia canta uma música comprida.
right.en: The whale sings a very long song.
right.es-MX: La ballena canta una canción larguísima.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna sings with her mouth wide open and her head tilted up while Theo and Lia listen; on the right a humpback whale sings under the sea with its head tilted up, little song notes drifting up, in the same singing pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Four horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a sea surface band, an underwater band, a deep sea band along the bottom.

left.es-MX: Theo toca tambor en su panza.

right.en: The gorilla drums on its chest.
right.es-MX: El gorila toca tambor en su pecho.

spreads.scene: On the left Theo pats a beat on his tummy with both hands while Nuna and Lia laugh; on the right a gorilla sits up and beats its chest with both hands, in the same drumming pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a jungle leaf band through the middle, a forest floor band along the bottom.

right.es-MX: El ave lira imita cualquier sonido.

spreads.scene: On the left Lia whistles like a bird with puckered lips while Nuna and Theo listen, surprised; on the right a lyrebird sings on a forest log with its lacy tail raised, beak open, in the same whistling pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a tall fern band through the middle, a forest log band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Os três batem o pé: tum, tum!

right.pt-BR: O coelho bate a pata: tum!
right.en: The rabbit thumps its foot: thump!
right.es-MX: El conejo golpea con la pata: ¡pum!

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Theo and Lia stomp their feet in a line, knees lifted high; on the right a rabbit thumps one strong back foot on the ground, in the same stomping pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a hedge band through the middle, a meadow band along the bottom.

right.pt-BR: A foca bate palmas embaixo d'água.
right.es-MX: La foca aplaude bajo el agua.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Lia clap their hands to the beat while Theo keeps time on a pot; on the right a seal claps its front flippers together under the water, in the same clapping pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Four horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a sea surface band, an underwater kelp band, a rocky seabed band along the bottom.

left.en: The three friends hum: hmm, hmm.

right.pt-BR: O beija-flor zumbe com as asas.
right.en: The hummingbird hums with its wings.
right.es-MX: El colibrí zumba con sus alas.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Theo and Lia hum with closed mouths and swaying heads, eyes half closed; on the right a hummingbird hovers by a flower, wings a blur, in the same swaying hover. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a flowering vine band through the middle, a garden band along the bottom.

left.en: Nuna taps two sticks: click, click!

right.pt-BR: O golfinho faz clique, clique, clique.
right.es-MX: El delfín hace clic, clic, clic.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna taps two sticks together with a big smile while Theo and Lia count along; on the right a dolphin swims with its head up and little click marks around its beak, in the same happy pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a sea surface band through the middle, a deep water band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Lia toca no tronco com um graveto.
left.en: Lia drums a log with a stick.
left.es-MX: Lia toca el tronco con un palito.

right.pt-BR: A cacatua também toca com graveto!
right.en: The palm cockatoo drums with a stick too!

spreads.scene: On the left Lia drums on a fallen log with a stick while Nuna and Theo dance beside her; on the right a palm cockatoo holds a stick in its foot and drums on a hollow tree branch, in the same drumming pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a treetop band through the middle, a fallen log band along the bottom.

right.pt-BR: O bugio canta mais alto ainda.
right.en: The howler monkey is even louder.
right.es-MX: El mono aullador canta más fuerte.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Theo and Lia sing loudly with their mouths wide open and arms up; on the right a howler monkey calls from a treetop with its mouth wide open, in the same loud pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a rainforest canopy band through the middle, a forest floor band along the bottom.

On the left Nuna, Theo and Lia sing softly with their fingers to their lips, leaning close together; on the right a cat purrs curled on a cushion with its eyes half closed, in the same quiet, cozy lean. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: an evening sky band across the top, a porch window band through the middle, a porch floor band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Fim do show! Os três agradecem.
left.en: The end! The three friends bow.

right.pt-BR: Os grilos tocam a noite inteira.
right.en: The crickets play all night long.
right.es-MX: Los grillos tocan toda la noche.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Theo and Lia take a bow together at dusk, holding hands; on the right crickets chirp on bent grass stems under the evening sky, in the same bowing shape. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a dusk sky band across the top, a tall grass band through the middle, a lawn band along the bottom.

cover_scene: Nuna, Theo, and Lia stand side-by-side, facing forward, with a small gorilla, rabbit, and dolphin scattered around them, all facing the children.
